Name: Horse Flute Anywhere
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
[b]Horse Flute Anywhere[/b] lets you summon your horse anywhere (even in the deepest mines) at the press of a button or by using the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Horse_Flute]horse flute[/url].

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/HorseFluteAnywhere/docs/screenshots/indoors.png[/img][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/HorseFluteAnywhere/docs/screenshots/dungeon.png[/img]

[b][color=#6aa84f]For non-English players, translations are included in the base mod. [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods]Contributions are welcome[/url]![/color][/b]


[size=6][b]Install[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=6][b]How to use[/b][/size]
You can summon your horse by...
[list]
[*]using the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Horse_Flute]horse flute[/url] item;
[*]pressing [font=Courier New]H[/font] (if you have a horse flute in your inventory, or you disable "Require Horse Flute" in the settings).
[/list]
This will work anywhere, even in the deepest mines.


[size=6][b]Settings[/b][/size]
You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure the mod in-game:
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]


[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later;
[*]Linux, Mac, and Windows;
[*]single-player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.
[/list]

[size=6][b]See also[/b][/size][list]

[/list]
